name: Weakness
overview: Scripture reveals that human weakness is a reality met with God's sustaining strength. Though believers may grow faint or face infirmities, God promises to increase their strength and supply their needs through Christ. The Spirit aids in our weakness by interceding on our behalf, empowering us to persevere in prayer and daily challenges. Ultimately, Christ strengthens us to do all things, demonstrating that our reliance on Him transforms weakness into divine empowerment.
